title: HCP1065 · expanded source streamline bundles
units_evidence: The official ICBM152 2009a template documentation declares millimetre sampling; source header units are retained when present.

space.name: MNI ICBM152 2009a asymmetric
space.reference: HCP1065 population-averaged tractography source declaration and original TrackVis headers
space.correspondence: The source publisher explicitly places HCP1065 average streamlines in ICBM 2009a nonlinear asymmetric space and instructs insertion of the corresponding T1/T2 images. Header decoding and complete reference field-of-view coverage are checked. Anatomical fit remains unreviewed. No new registration, mirroring or relation to another template is introduced.

sources.title: HCP1065 population-averaged tractography atlas
sources.version: Yeh 2022 TRK distribution; SHA256-pinned source archive
sources.citation: Yeh FC. Population-based tract-to-region connectome of the human brain and its hierarchical topology. Nature Communications 13, 4933 (2022). doi:10.1038/s41467-022-32595-4. Derived from Human Connectome Project data; retain the accompanying HCP acknowledgment.

sources.title: MNI ICBM152 nonlinear asymmetric template
sources.citation: Fonov VS et al. Unbiased average age-appropriate atlases for pediatric studies. NeuroImage 54 (2011), 313-327. doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2010.07.033.

streamline_evidence: Source population-averaged computational tractography; these trajectories are not observed axons, validated functional connections or individual anatomical boundaries.
streamline_notes: All original decoded source streamlines and points are retained in RAS millimetres. No smoothing, point simplification, interpolation or additional registration is applied.
Preview, standard and detail views select complete source trajectories by a recorded deterministic source-index rule. Display density is not anatomical density, axon count or probability.
The source point used for navigation is a sampled trajectory vertex near the point-weighted centroid, not an independently identified anatomical landmark.
Streamline endpoints and unequal left/right counts do not establish terminal connections, axon numbers or the distribution of normal anatomical asymmetry.
Separately delivered occupancy maps and population-probability maps are not used in this package.

teaching_sequences.title: Association bundles: source group 1
teaching_sequences.objective: Inspect these delivered source trajectories and their spatial courses in the documented MRI template.
teaching_sequences.instruction: Begin with full MRI sections. Select a bundle, inspect its source name and side, and compare the 2D physical slab with the 3D course. Hide other groups before increasing display detail. Display samples retain complete source lines and every selected vertex.
teaching_sequences.evidence_limit: Unreviewed computational trajectories. They are not observed axons, complete nerve boundaries, validated endpoints, axon counts or a measure of individual normal variation. Source-table discrepancies remain in the structure notes.
teaching_sequences.step_prompt: Locate this source-defined structure in the full available sections, then magnify at the same point and compare the 3D representation.
teaching_sequences.step_question: Which source structure or class is selected, and what does its representation not establish?
